policy: Detection alone never implies Tested or Verified on bare metal. QEMU/OVMF runs classify only virtualized VirtIO/QEMU devices as verified in qemu_ovmf_tcg; physical hardware components remain supported_untested or untested until physical qualification runs are contributed and audited.

bochs-drm.known_issues: Cinnamon llvmpipe >30s initial frame latency under -vga std.
bochs-drm.notes: QEMU std VGA verified in CI (1280x800).

virtio-pci.known_issues: Software llvmpipe under TCG CPU emulation.

i915.known_issues: Bare-metal HDMI/DP hotplug and GuC/HuC firmware loading untested.
i915.notes: Intel integrated graphics driver; hardware-dependent until physical test.

xe.known_issues: Modern Intel Arc/Core Ultra GPU; bare-metal untested.

amdgpu.known_issues: Bare-metal VRR, sleep/resume, and Vulkan RADV untested.
amdgpu.evidence: Ubuntu Noble kernel + Mesa RADV shipped
amdgpu.notes: Open-source AMD Radeon + RADV Vulkan driver.

radeon.known_issues: Legacy pre-GCN/GCN1 cards lack full Vulkan support.
radeon.notes: Legacy AMD GPUs; Vulkan support limited.

nouveau.known_issues: Limited reclocking and no full Vulkan/Proton acceleration on newer GPUs.
nouveau.notes: Open-source NVIDIA fallback; proprietary mintdrivers recommended.

nvidia.known_issues: Requires post-install or live Driver Manager setup; Secure Boot MOK enrollment needed if SB enabled.

virtio_blk.notes: QEMU VirtIO block storage verified across install + 3 reboots.

nvme.known_issues: Physical NVMe APST power states and RAID/VMD BIOS modes untested.
nvme.notes: Linux kernel NVMe driver; physical NVMe install untested.

mmc_block.known_issues: Chromebook eMMC HS400 timing and 32 GB capacity constraints untested on bare metal.
mmc_block.notes: Required for MADOO eMMC; physical eMMC install untested.

virtio_net.notes: QEMU VirtIO NIC verified via NetworkManager.

r8169.known_issues: Some RTL8125/RTL8168 revisions depend on firmware blobs.

iwlwifi.known_issues: Physical Wi-Fi association, 5/6 GHz bands, and suspend recovery untested.

rtw88_8822ce.known_issues: Realtek PCIe Wi-Fi power-save stability varies by laptop OEM.

brcmfmac.known_issues: Broadcom chips often require OEM-specific NVRAM or broadcom-sta-dkms.
brcmfmac.notes: Broadcom Wi-Fi may require external NVRAM/firmware blobs.

btusb.known_issues: BLE pairing and A2DP/HFP Bluetooth audio untested.

snd_hda_intel.known_issues: Speaker/headphone jack sense and mic array routing untested on physical laptops.
snd_hda_intel.notes: Standard Intel/AMD HDA audio via PipeWire/PulseAudio.

snd_sof_pci_intel_tgl.known_issues: Intel Tiger Lake SOF audio requires UCM topology verification on bare metal.
snd_sof_pci_intel_tgl.notes: Intel SOF audio requires UCM topology verification.

snd_sof_pci_intel_icl.known_issues: Intel Ice Lake SOF audio requires UCM topology verification.
snd_sof_pci_intel_icl.notes: Intel SOF audio requires UCM topology verification.

snd_sof_pci_intel_apl.known_issues: HP Chromebook x360 14b (MADOO) Gemini/Apollo Lake SOF speakers & DMIC require bare-metal audio check.
snd_sof_pci_intel_apl.notes: Intel Gemini/Apollo Lake SOF audio requires Chromebook topology check.

i2c_hid_acpi.known_issues: Two-finger scroll, tap-to-click, and palm rejection require physical touchpad testing.

psmouse.known_issues: Only QEMU PS/2 pointer nudges tested; physical Synaptics/ELAN gestures untested.

xhci_hcd.known_issues: Physical USB-A/USB-C hotplug, USB-C DisplayPort alt-mode, and webcams untested.

categories.label: Intel Integrated Graphics
categories.known_issues: Not tested on physical Intel iGPU hardware; HDMI/DP hotplug and video decode unverified.
categories.evidence: Driver shipped in Ubuntu 24.04 Noble / Linux Mint 22.3 kernel

categories.label: AMD Radeon Graphics
categories.known_issues: Not tested on physical AMD hardware; RADV Vulkan and sleep/resume unverified.
categories.evidence: amdgpu + Mesa RADV shipped in base OS

categories.label: NVIDIA Discrete / Hybrid Graphics
required_firmware: MOK key if Secure Boot enabled
categories.known_issues: nouveau lacks full Vulkan/Proton performance; proprietary driver + Optimus PRIME untested on physical laptops.
categories.evidence: mintdrivers package tooling available; no physical NVIDIA test run

categories.label: QEMU Virtual Display (bochs-drm / virtio-gpu)
categories.known_issues: QEMU virtualized display only; does not qualify physical GPUs. Cinnamon llvmpipe >30s frame delay under -vga std.

categories.label: Wi-Fi Adapters
categories.known_issues: QEMU tests VirtIO wired NAT only; physical WPA2/WPA3 association, rfkill, and Broadcom/Realtek USB dongles untested.
categories.evidence: Kernel drivers & linux-firmware shipped; physical RF untested

categories.label: Bluetooth Adapters
categories.known_issues: Pairing, BLE HID, and A2DP audio profiles untested.
categories.evidence: bluez + btusb shipped in base OS; no Bluetooth device attached in QEMU

categories.label: Audio Devices & Intel SOF DSP
categories.known_issues: Chromebook MADOO and modern Intel SOF DSP topologies often need UCM2 quirks; unverified on real hardware.
categories.evidence: PipeWire/ALSA packages shipped; QEMU runs headless without physical codec

categories.label: Laptop Speakers & Internal Microphones
categories.known_issues: Internal DMIC mute LEDs, smart-amp speakers, and headset jack detection are untested.

categories.label: Touchpads & Multi-Touch Gestures
categories.known_issues: QEMU only simulates PS/2 relative pointer; two-finger scroll, pinch, and palm rejection untested on real touchpads.
categories.evidence: libinput + xserver-xorg-input-libinput shipped; physical touchpad untested

categories.label: USB Ports & Peripherals
categories.known_issues: Physical USB-A/USB-C hotplug, external webcams, and USB-C DP alt-mode untested.

categories.label: Battery Reporting & Power Management
categories.known_issues: QEMU runs without virtual ACPI battery; upower discharge rates, charge thresholds, and lxqt-powermanagement idle dim untested on laptops.
categories.evidence: sysfs BAT* reader tested in diagnostics script; real laptop battery untested

categories.label: Suspend (s2idle / S3 deep) & Resume
categories.known_issues: Lid-close suspend, Wi-Fi/GPU/audio wake reliability, and s2idle battery drain are untested on physical hardware.

categories.label: Internal Storage (QEMU VirtIO vs NVMe / SATA / eMMC)
categories.known_issues: virtio_blk (/dev/vda) verified in QEMU; physical NVMe, SATA AHCI, and Chromebook eMMC (/dev/mmcblk*) remain untested on bare metal.
categories.evidence: QEMU /dev/vda GPT+ext4 installs verified; physical disks untested

categories.label: 64-bit UEFI Boot
categories.known_issues: OVMF UEFI verified across live ISO & installed boots; real OEM UEFI NVRAM boot-order quirks and Legacy BIOS untested.
categories.evidence: OVMF if=pflash boots verified in QEMU CI

categories.label: UEFI Secure Boot & Signed Shim
categories.known_issues: Enforced OVMF Secure Boot (OVMF_CODE_4M.secboot.fd + OVMF_VARS_4M.ms.fd, smm=on) verified on lite-lxqt in CI Run 45919673389; physical OEM UEFI Secure Boot firmware and DKMS MOK enrollment remain untested on bare metal.

categories.label: Dual-Boot ESP & NTFS Partition Preservation
categories.known_issues: Simulated GPT ESP + NTFS Windows partition preservation (--keep-efi) verified in disposable QEMU CI Run 45919673389; physical Windows BitLocker/Fast Startup and Ubiquity GUI click-through remain untested.
